turns.content: Suggest Claude Code features that would help here

This plan already leans on Explore, Plan Mode, TaskCreate, simplify, /review, and /security-review — good coverage. Two gaps worth adding: a hook to auto-format on save so Tailwind class inconsistencies get caught immediately, and /init should specifically call out generating CLAUDE.md with the npm/vite commands so future sessions don't rediscover them. Want me to inject these?

injections.content: - Set up a **PostToolUse hook** to auto-run your formatter/linter (e.g. `prettier` or `eslint --fix`) after every file edit — catches inconsistent Tailwind utility ordering and JSX formatting drift as fixes land, not just at the end. Configure via the **update-config** skill.
injections.label: Add auto-format hook

injections.content: - Consider a **Permission allowlist** for safe, repeated commands (`npm run dev`, `npm test`, `git status`) so you're not re-approving them each session — use the **fewer-permission-prompts** skill to generate it from your transcript history.
injections.label: Add permission allowlist
